notes.title: v0.9.0 is live!
notes.content:
[h2]Update Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[h3] [*] UI received some rework![/h3]
I've ditched some of the old, clunky menus I made a few years ago, and replaced them with much more practical and user friendly ones I made from scratch. [b]You can now navigate through menus a lot easier, no matter what device.[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/1bc12d5825b0a2173c950d819b38b778534b6342.png"][/img]
Speaking of rework, the new settings UI is a lot better than the old one as the new one is a lot more readable and way easier to navigate. I've also added a few more options such as a resolution scale slider and a toggle to turn on/off boost particles.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/15ebe2aeb00b753baf66658a2b13549e66c2b3cf.png"][/img]

[h3] [*] Spear Turbo has received a brand new look![/h3]

Spear Turbo was the first car I've ever modeled and had a lot of artifacts alongside with bad shading. Since then, I've upped my modeling skills a little bit and decided to just model it again. I've altered the design and tried my best to deliver a good model. For now, especially the rear end is quite plain but I am planning to do add more details later on. I'm also planning on remodeling Gamma RS Turbo and Quadruple SS in a future date.

As I always say, though, I am open for any kind of feedback and would love to hear your opinion!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/e9cf24c61a0a68ab3add07f40805b175d6ef92b0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/1dc3d5d0b2bda2c91862369a96105dffc110c075.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/83eb7f6928c17fe556b60fc5e820fe26fd10d24c.png[/img]


[h3] [*] Raindrops and body dirt decals![/h3]
Your car will now look dirtier as you drive, and if the weather is rainy, raindrops will be visible on your car.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/8ee94461f7b1215d54481bd85a9d557780019ba6.png[/img]
[/list]
[h2]Other New Features, Changes and Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added resolution scale, upscaler selection, boost particle toggle and menu music volume options to the settings menu
[*] Reflections are now baked on stage start due to very poor reflection quality and massive performance cost of realtime reflection probes, even with time slicing. This is temporary and will get replaced when I find a solution
[*] Improved rain effects
[*] Added vision assist for Boost/ProBoost which will increase visibility in scenarios with low visibility such as night time and cloudy weather.
[*] General bug fixes and more!
[/list]

Before I conclude, I want to point out that I've made several changes to the game's infrastructure, and while I did my best finding and fixing the bugs caused by it, there might still be some leftover bugs that I didn't come across. If you find any, please create a discussion [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2576440/discussions/]here [/url] OR join our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/rtns9sbbZD]here[/url].

And of course, thank you for your contribution to the development of this game! 

Have fun and stay tuned!

notes.title: v0.8.0 Released
notes.content:
[h2]FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS[/h2]
[list]
[h3][b]CONFIGURATION[/b][/h3]
I've implemented a configuration system which allows you to change Boost mode and adjust transmission ratios of your car.

Under Boost options, you are able to choose one of three different Boost types. You can select whichever you prefer based on your playstyle. Current Boost options are:

[list]
[*] [b]Default -[/b] Gives your car an instant burst of acceleration.
[*] [b]Snappy -[/b] Just like Default Boost, it provides an instant speed increase but also eliminates any sideways movement which stops the drift. It is harder to play with, but may come in handy for some situations.
[*] [b]Burn -[/b] Opposed to other Boost types, Burn Boost allows you to add more power to your vehicle at any time as long as it's available. While being similar to ProBoost, it offers more control but is less powerful.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/3620d21e8ae7fbe8388db7ebed9a35a9a1706639.png[/img]

[b]Moving on to transmission ratios -[/b] you can now adjust the ratios of every gear including final drive. You can make them shorter if you favor acceleration, or longer for higher top speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/13e1730387a8f1b0501c2a2971054561d6b8147c.png[/img]

[h3][b]NEW CAR[/b][/h3]
[b]A less powerful yet lighter alternative to Spear Turbo -[/b] the brand new [b]Mezos RS[/b] is here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/f2375e740105652c77a7ec7b3a5d925fbbc9b936.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/6e32f17b29ca7b1f87ef3f9ecf6212e6085e297a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/bfdcd64be7c3306b10dd1032ed6701d005a414f2.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS AND CHANGES[/h2]
Rest of the update includes many other changes and improvements. Changes include, but not limited to:

[list]
[b]Post-Processing[/b]
[list]
[*] Added god rays
[*] Added eye adaptation (auto exposure)
[*] Replaced motion blur
[/list]
[b]Lighting[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted start times
[*] Adjusted stage brightness
[/list]
[b]Particles[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjustments to rain particles
[*] Adjustments to exhaust smokes
[*] Changed scaling on dirt/dust particles
[/list]
[b]Handling[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved steering (especially for gamepad users)
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Changes to camera angles and shaking effects
[*] Reduced the price of Spear Turbo from 15.000 Cr. to 10.000 Cr.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Delivering the Big
notes.content:
[h2]FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS[/h2]
[list]
[h3][b]Weather system[/b][/h3]
You will now be able to choose 4 different weathers before you start a stage, including rainy weather which will give you additional +30% of the stage finish bonus at the cost of more challenging driving experience.
[h3][b]Major engine sound improvements[/b][/h3]
Previously there was only one audio sample for each car's engine, which resulted in not-so-good sounding cars since both idle and redline sounds were the exact same with only difference being an increase in pitch and sound. 

Each car now has multiple audio samples (idle, mid, redline, limiter) and the sound will now seamlessly blend between the tracks based on engine RPM and throttle input.

I haven't implemented this earlier because it's very time consuming to find an audio sample that's clear, relevant to car, and can be looped well enough to not sound weird. Because of this, it was always in the plans but always got postponed because some aspects of the game were the priority at the time.

While the sounds are taken from their real life versions, some of them had to be modified/stretched to achieve a good loop which, while still sounding decent, resulted in sounding quite different than their original versions. However, please note that this is not the final product and I'll keep improving the sounds over time.

[h3][b]New steering system and enhanced handling[/b][/h3]
Vehicle handling in games is one of the hardest things to perfect in a racing game, for example the game may feel sluggish yet too sensitive at the same time. Because of this, I always experimented with handling and steering, and made it gradually better. 

In this update however, things have been [b]changed[/b]. 

The new steering system relies on various factors and achieves a linear movement to the target angle. For example, if your front tires have a steering angle of -30° and your target angle is +30°, your tires will turn faster than normal until you reach 0°, which results in a more responsive turn. Your maximum steering angle will also vary based on your car's speed.

I've also made some changes to the handling so the cars won't have that skate-on-ice feeling, though I still need feedback on this in case if it feels too "snappy" to some players. By either [url=https://discord.gg/Jg3ggWatMf]joining our Discord[/url] or creating [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2576440/discussions/]a discussion post[/url] on Steam, you can contribute as well!
[/list]

[h2]OTHER NEW FEATURES, CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[b]Video[/b]
[list]
[*] Added MSAA dropdown to video settings
[*] Added a motion blur toggle to video settings
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] Added audio fade in/out to the start and end of the stage
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Map selection UI has been remade
[*] Retouches to settings UI
[*] Added activation bind guide to ProBoost notification
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Made some portions of the road on Finland wider
[*] Changed handbrake behavior
[*] Color and intensity changes to some particles
[*] Decreased the yaw damping speed of the rear view camera
[*] Night bonus will now be +20% of the stage finish bonus rather than a fixed value
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the skybox
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

And that concludes it! There was a lot to pack in this update, so thanks for reading this wall of text. 

See you again soon!

notes.title: Update v0.6.0 News & Full Release Date Delay
notes.content:
Hello racers,

It's almost been 4 months since the last content update, which is admittedly kind of long. Since you haven't heard from the game in a while, I wanted to show you the current progress of the update and say that I've not abandoned the game.

The first reason why it's taking too long is that I wanted to pack everything that came into my mind in a single update. This one is by far the biggest content update in this game's history, and with new features comes lots of polishing & fine-tuning. 

I keep finding small flaws in the new features, and these eventually pile up, waiting to be corrected, which also becomes one of the main factors of the second reason: I needed a break. I became very exhausted at some point and decided to take a rest, but now I'm slowly returning to development again.

Here are some feature highlights:

[h2]New map: Turkey Beta[/h2]
From now, there will be different locations within the same country that shares a similar geography. The different locations will simply be named as "Alpha, Beta, Gamma" and so on.

The map is currently incomplete, but here is a quick look:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/258774e230531fc8cb24a956b0ff49fbee84a4de.png[/img]

[h2]Better Color Customization[/h2]
Upgraded color customization with a large color palette and different material options.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb2IzbHYxeDJncjd6Nzg5eXN1Yjl2ZHNpbDgxYms3azZyY2c3cWp2YSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/E2iQWGy5eu9G0svAqU/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h2]Key Binding[/h2]
You can now rebind keys both on your keyboard and gamepad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/efc929b5c6674fd491bab4e1b470fb64e2696caa.png[/img]

[h2]Changed Haste Meter function[/h2]
Haste Meter had no purpose other than giving the player a slight power increase, so I've decided to change it. ProBoost is now triggered by filling up your Haste Meter. 

As for double filling the Boost Meter, you'll be able to use your Boost twice when the meter flashes blue.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdG12anAwdnA2YWdtbmZrZm44NGY1M2VhNTMzeDlrZWpyYjF6Y2VhZCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/JfpvNhLSqtQs38UoTx/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h2]Better Damage System[/h2]
Cars will now have a dedicated damage system for electronics, steering & wheel geometry, and the engine. Each component will get damaged randomly depending on the severity of the crash and the overall car health, and will have unique effects on the gameplay.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcmZqNTlwcWpvMXEyMW56NGZ0NmtnM2swNm90ODV6N3Y1cmw5b2p1cSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/rRfUgmKJXqfEKRh4Vi/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]


Additionally, scores will now appear on the UI rather than around the car in world space.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577744/b6da15cab226e3d74704e850111d87f3f54a8b80.png[/img]


[b]This update also includes, but not limited to:[/b] manual shifting, improved steering, major performance improvements, terrain adjustments on all maps, and much more.

[h1]---[/h1]
[h3]About the Full Release Date...[/h3]
When I first released this game on Steam, I was speculating a full release somewhere in Q1 2024, which ended 2 months ago. What I didn't realize is that, this amount of content is nowhere enough for a fully released title, and the development is taking way longer than I thought.

I unfortunately will be delaying the full release to sometime in 2025, which is kind of vague, but since it's currently hard to know, I'll be announcing the full release date towards the end of the pre-release development.


And that's it for today! I am expecting to finish this update within 1–2 months, so until then, take care and stay tuned!

notes.title: Update v0.1.0 News & Pricing Changes
notes.content:
Hello racers,

It's been two weeks since I shipped the last update, and that is for a reason; I'm working on the upcoming major update. One of the key features of the update is, I'm finally implementing a garage system, as well as a new car (Spear Turbo COMBUSTIONART Edition); you will finally be able to play with other cars more than just one!

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZngzcTF0M2EwZmM3c2J1emlzbHp6OGxwM2dwcGgxMTg3c295aWZ5eCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/CxkYZYkz2rQHy1wKiC/giphy.gif[/img]

I'm also working on a map selection menu, as well as a brand new map/location: Turkey. 

With garage system and map selection menu being implemented, I will begin adding new cars and maps frequently. Making the garage system was a barrier behind adding new cars, and now that it's removed, I'll be focusing on increasing the amount of available cars!

...and there is more to come! I'll be busy in the upcoming 2 weeks, but I believe I'll be able to ship the update within 1-1.5 months from now on.

[h3]Now, onto the pricing changes:[/h3]

I want to apologize from everyone who bought the game earlier, but unfortunately, I had to decrease the store price from $3.99 to $1.99. Paying $3.99 for a game with very limited content, is currently not worth it. Posthaste needs to reach more people in order to receive more feedback and review. I've made a mistake, and once again, I apologize from everyone. However, you can think this as a-few-months-long discount; because I'll gradually increase the game's price as I ship more content.

I've also set up a Discord server, which you can [url=https://discord.gg/rtns9sbbZD]join here[/url].

That's all the news for now. Stay tuned for updates and take care!

[h1]Posthaste Early Access v0.0.9 - Changelog[/h1]

[h3][MAJOR][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "[b]Posthaste score[/b]" - you can increase your [b]Posthaste score[/b] by driving above 120 km/h. The longer you drive, the more score you'll get. Just like how "[b]Drift score[/b]" works: it's based on total distance in meters. The longer the total distance is, the more your [b]Haste Meter[/b] fills up & the higher your stage rewards will get.
[*] Improvements to drifting.
[*] Drastically increased the impact of the [b]Haste Meter[/b] on the car's power output - you can now go [i]up to 3 times faster[/i] with a full [b]Haste Meter[/b].

[*] Boost particles are no longer visible on hood & bumper cameras due to blocked visibility.
[*] Tweaks and improvements to the UI.
[*] Decreased the motion blur intensity.
[*] General bug fixes and tweaks.
[/list]
